serverInfo.name: sap.s4/ce-freightorder-0001-mcp
serverInfo.title: SAP S4 Freight Order MCP
serverInfo.description: MCP server for SAP S/4HANA Freight Order (A2X) service.

tools.name: get_metadata_sap_self
tools.title: get_metadata_sap_self
tools.description:
Get metadata of the OData service with optional filtering to reduce token consumption.
Returns the metadata in XML format, which can be used to discover available entities and their properties.
Call this endpoint every time before you call other tools to ensure understanding of the schema.
Based on the metadata, you can dynamically create an OData request.

Use filtering parameters to get specific metadata sections. Without parameters, this tool returns the complete XML metadata (which might be huge).
Only use the specified enum values for the filtering parameters.

tools.name: list_freightorder_for_sap_self
tools.title: list_FreightOrder_for_sap_self
tools.description: Retrieve a list of Freight Orders. Supports OData query options for filtering, sorting, ranking ($top), skipping ($skip), expanding related entities (stops, items), counting, and selecting specific properties. Use to check TransportationOrderExecSts and TranspOrdGoodsMovementStatus for transit delay diagnosis.

tools.name: get_freightorder_for_sap_self
tools.title: get_FreightOrder_for_sap_self
tools.description: Retrieve a single Freight Order entity by its TransportationOrderUUID key. Supports $select and $expand to include related stops and items.

tools.name: list_freightorderstop_for_sap_self
tools.title: list_FreightOrderStop_for_sap_self
tools.description: Retrieve a list of Freight Order Stops. Filter by TransportationOrderUUID to get stops for a specific freight order. Check TranspOrdStopPlanTranspDteTme vs TranspOrdStopDteTme for delay detection.

tools.name: list_freightorderitem_for_sap_self
tools.title: list_FreightOrderItem_for_sap_self
tools.description: Retrieve a list of Freight Order Items. Filter by TransportationOrderUUID to get items for a specific freight order. Shows ProductID and quantities being transported.
